entries.en: Lemme see. Some front desk guy at City[n]Hall became a stalker, right?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: The hell are you guys!?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Are you that stalker!? Haven't you ever[n]stopped to consider how your ex feels?

entries.en: She's my property! I can do whatever[n]I want with her!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: You can't treat someone like shit[n]just 'cause they did it to you! What[n]a load of crap!

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: We're gonna change the hearts of all the[n]bastards like you!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: There's plenty of people out there[n]more evil than me!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: What about Madarame? He stole[n]everything from me, but you're[n]letting him off the hook!?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: ...Madarame? The hell's this guy goin' on[n]about?

entries.speaker: Morgana
entries.en: Get ready! Here he comes!
We'll settle this in an instant!
We've got no other choice!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Don't get cocky, you kids!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Don't get cocky, you kids!

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: I... I'm sorry. Please forgive me...

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: That evil teacher used me, then threw me[n]out on the street. That's what caused my[n]fixation on her...
Which person?

entries.speaker: Ryuji
entries.en: Hold on, are you talkin' about that guy[n]you mentioned earlier? Madarame?

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: You don't have to be so hard on him[n]anymore. He seems like he's sorry.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: So, this person you trusted... Is this the[n]Madarame that you were talking about[n]before?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: I was afraid of being thrown away again,[n]like some worthless thing...

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Don't worry, I'll let go of my love,[n]for good.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Treated like a thing...? What a horrible[n]experience.

entries.speaker: Ann
entries.en: Next time, love your partner not as a thing,[n]but as a human being, okay?

entries.speaker: Shadow Nakanohara
entries.en: Yes, of course.

entries.speaker: Morgana
